result:
**Verdict: hold it. One fix needed.**

**Problem**
- "Elevate your mornings" uses "elevate", which is on our banned word list. It's also generic filler that doesn't fit the warm, plain, unhurried voice.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "left Bristol this morning" | Transactional fact about this order, consistent with hand-packing in Bristol. Fine, provided the dispatch is true for this send. |
| "a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony" | Product facts, cleared by the product team. |
| "pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted (subscription terms). |
| No stats, superlatives, guarantees, health or green claims, fake urgency, or testimonials | None found. |

No disclosure label is needed, since this is our own email and not a creator or affiliate post. UK spelling is fine.

**Suggested fix**

> Subject: Your October tins are on the way
>
> Hi Priya,
>
> Your subscription box left Bristol this morning. This month it's a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony. If you're away next month, you can pause or cancel any time from your account.
>
> The Pebblebrook team

Sam still needs to approve it before it goes out. Also confirm the subject line: it says "October tins" but today is 17 November, so check the month is right.
